description: The Color tab gets a Nodes sub-tab (both clip kinds): NodeStrip (add, long-press menu: turn off/on, reset, duplicate, delete, the 8-node limit) over the selected node's Adjust page (saturation, contrast, hue, temperature, tint, mix, all zero-centred like the legacy sliders) and a free-text name (at most 40 characters, the optional GradeNodeV2.name field).
